summary: D1-backed page rendering wired behind PAGES_FROM_D1, OFF by default and inert (flag set nowhere: not wrangler.jsonc, not a committed .dev.vars, not a prod secret). File render stays the live path; it is also the fallback on flag-off, no row, empty html, draft, has_components, non-route, or a throwing lookup - an unreachable D1 cannot 500 a page. 4 of 16 candidate routes are eligible today (/arts/write-life, /learning, /privacy, /terms); the other 12 fall back because ./ relative images resolve to hashed /_astro/ URLs at build and those 26 sibling images 404 on the CDN, so rewriting would ship broken images - they need hosting plus PAGES_CDN_BASE. Markdown is pre-rendered at ingest into site_pages.html so the Worker carries no markdown library: 0.75 MB gzipped vs 0.74 MB baseline (bundling Astro's processor pulled in shiki at 2.88 MB, and it landed even with the flag off, so it would not have been inert). Nothing deployed, nothing pushed.
